trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Strait Risk
trends.summary: Trump threatens to obliterate Iranian power plants if Strait of Hormuz isn't reopened within 48 hours; Iran counters with threats to target US/Israel energy infrastructure and desalination plants. This geopolitical flashpoint directly threatens 20%+ of global oil transit and has triggered crypto liquidations ($240M+) and bond volatility spikes (MOVE index at 109, highest since April).

trends.name: Middle East Conflict Escalation
trends.summary: Israel's Defense Minister announces destruction of all bridges over Litani River in southern Lebanon and implements 'Beit Hanoun scenario' in Gaza border villages, signaling major military escalation. Combined with Iran tensions, this widens regional conflict scope with implications for commodity prices and supply chain disruption.

trends.name: Oil Supply Disruption & Tanker Activity
trends.summary: Heavy tanker activity reported at critical chokepoints; Saudi exporting 4.5M barrels/day via East-to-West pipeline amid geopolitical tensions. Energy commodities are repricing on supply chain concerns, with knock-on effects for inflation, transportation costs, and consumer goods pricing.

trends.name: Fed Signals Weak Job Creation & Rate Hold
trends.summary: Powell warns committee is 'very very concerned' about historically low job creation; adjusted for overcounting, trend job creation is effectively at zero over past 6 months. This signals the Fed may hold rates longer than markets expected, pressuring growth stocks and creating recession risks.

trends.name: Central Bank Actions Spooking Markets
trends.summary: Global rate freeze and central bank moves creating market volatility; international stocks underperforming as geopolitical risks dominate. This drives flight-to-safety positioning and favors US dollar strength over international equity diversification.

trends.name: Nvidia Competition & AI Capex Concerns
trends.summary: Nvidia customers quietly building semiconductor alternatives while OpenAI's data center pivot raises Wall Street spending concerns ahead of potential IPO. Despite 'AI is here to stay' cheerleading, market recognizes structural capex pressures and emerging competitive threats to Nvidia's dominance.

trends.name: Tariffs & Consumer Goods Inflation
trends.summary: Tariffs and inflation driving price spikes across consumer staples: menstrual products, chocolate, berries, pineapples, and plastic goods all seeing cost increases. Walmart accelerating digital price labels by end of 2026, signaling retailers preparing for dynamic pricing amid inflationary pressures.

trends.name: High-Yield & Preferred Stock Demand
trends.summary: Investors hunting for yield amid rate uncertainty, driving demand for preferred stocks with 7-12% yields, BDCs, and closed-end funds trading at NAV discounts. DoorDash defying weak macro signals strength in selected growth names, while dividend sustainability concerns emerge around distribution coverage.

trends.name: Immigration Policy & Workplace Impacts
trends.summary: Trump announces ICE deployment to airports Monday; companies adjusting to operate with fewer workers in AI era. This creates dual pressures: tighter labor supply and AI-driven productivity gains, benefiting automation vendors while pressuring labor-intensive sectors.

trends.name: Retirement Income & Reverse Mortgage Risks
trends.summary: Multiple stories highlight retirement planning complexities: reverse mortages running out of funds, 0% credit cards masking debt, second home purchases straining retirement budgets. Signals growing anxiety among retirees about portfolio sustainability and sequence-of-returns risk in volatile markets.

trends.name: Geopolitical Missile & Nuclear Threats
trends.summary: Mossad recruitment signals nuclear industry intelligence operations; UK confirms Cyprus bases won't support Iran offensive actions. Underlying nuclear escalation risk amid conventional conflict, creating tail-risk premium in energy and defense stocks.

trends.name: Precious Metals & Alternative Asset Demand
trends.summary: Wealthy consumers shifting to jewelry and colored gemstones as inflation hedges; gold mining plays (Mako Mining) attracting attention. Reflects portfolio repositioning away from traditional equities amid macro uncertainty and geopolitical risks.
